purpose: Reviewed file-level keep/move/merge/delete budget for the remaining clean-cut refactor.
authority: Temporary execution tracking only; Knowledge, source/tests, and Git remain authoritative.
rules: Every tracked file at the snapshot plus this manifest has exactly one disposition.
Move and merge target paths name accepted owners; no old-path compatibility exports survive.
Delete means delete after replacement parity, not delete before its callers are cut over.
New files consume explicit reserves; exceeding a reserve requires deleting or merging another file in the same slice.
File-count reduction must come from deleting obsolete authority, compatibility, and duplication—not combining unrelated responsibilities.

for: replacement Runtime lifecycle and recovery contracts
paired harness adapters, controlled runner, and external judge contracts

auditChanges.change: Keep test:coordinator as a focused developer command but remove its duplicate invocation from audit:codewiki after the suite manifests are updated.
Delete Lab and self-dogfood scripts when their files are removed; replace benchmark commands with repository-root paired harness commands.
Delete legacy root counts after all listed paths are gone; assert only final target roots and dependency directions.

reasonCatalog.target_owned: Already belongs to an accepted target owner; retain unless a later focused audit proves redundancy.
reasonCatalog.move_target_owner: Semantics survive but current path names the wrong owner.
reasonCatalog.merge_small_contract: Small single-purpose contract belongs in an existing owner module; merge without compatibility export.
reasonCatalog.legacy_quality: Legacy Quality/Loop stack is replaced by Candidate, Evidence, Check Result, Exit Report, and route semantics.
reasonCatalog.legacy_trace: Legacy local Trace/ChangeRecord authority is replaced by canonical Change operations and deterministic projections.
reasonCatalog.legacy_view: Generic Trace-derived view is replaced by bounded WorkState, Alignment, or client projection.
reasonCatalog.legacy_work_state: Old Trace/ChangeRecord WorkState is replaced by canonical ProjectWorkState reduction.
reasonCatalog.legacy_trace_host: Legacy trace-host lifecycle duplicates generic Runtime coordination and Pi Harness execution.
reasonCatalog.legacy_lab: Lab/optimizer/promotion machinery is replaced by repository-root externally judged paired benchmarks.
reasonCatalog.self_dogfood: Source-checkout self-dogfood machinery is forbidden during stabilization and has no final product owner.
reasonCatalog.barrel_cleanup: Broad or one-line compatibility barrel expands internal API without owning behavior.
reasonCatalog.duplicate_adapter: Permissive or duplicate adapter is replaced by bounded canonical Evidence/Verification machinery.
reasonCatalog.temporary_execution: Temporary refactoring execution evidence is deleted when target topology is complete.
reasonCatalog.generated_placeholder: Legacy runtime/generated-state placeholder is not source truth.
reasonCatalog.test_follows_source: Test survives and moves with its source responsibility.
reasonCatalog.test_obsolete: Test proves behavior or structure intentionally deleted by clean cut.
reasonCatalog.test_merge: Assertions survive inside the target owner test; separate file disappears.
